description: Move the supported SSO provider id list, its type and isSupportedProvider into the pure packages/auth/src/lib/sso/types.ts; mspSsoResolution.ts re-exports them so existing imports are unchanged.
TenantAuthPolicy gains clientPortalSsoProviders: SsoProviderId[] | null (null = offer every available provider); DEFAULT_TENANT_AUTH_POLICY sets it to null.
normalizeTenantAuthPolicy reads settings.sso.clientPortalSsoProviders: non-array -> null; array -> supported ids only, deduplicated, canonical order (google, azure-ad, keycloak).
applyPolicyChange carries clientPortalSsoProviders through (undefined keeps previous, explicit array or null replaces).
validatePolicyChange rejects a requested clientPortalSsoProviders list containing an unsupported id with guard code client_portal_sso_provider_invalid.
Pure offeredClientPortalSsoProviders(available, policy): available when the list is null, otherwise available intersected with the list, canonical order.
saveTenantAuthPolicy persists the whole normalized policy object into settings.sso instead of a hand-enumerated field list, so clientPortalSsoProviders is saved and audited with before/after.
listClientPortalAvailableSsoProviders(tenantId): on EE, each of google/azure-ad/keycloak where tenant credentials OR app fallback credentials exist (tenant Keycloak realm now counts); [] on CE.

discoverClientPortalSsoProviders(tenantId) returns offeredClientPortalSsoProviders(available, loadTenantAuthPolicy(tenantId)), so the signed discovery cookie and therefore /resolve only carry offered providers.

getClientPortalSignInSsoProviders({ tenantSlug, portalDomain }) resolves tenant context via resolveClientPortalSsoTenantContext and returns the offered list; returns [] and logs a warning on any failure.
Client portal sign-in page computes the offered list server-side and passes it through ClientPortalSignIn and ClientLoginForm to SsoProviderButtons as offeredProviders.

SsoProviderButtons: when offeredProviders is supplied, visible set = edition set intersected with offeredProviders from the first render, and /api/auth/providers is not fetched; discovery still drives enabled/disabled; MSP behavior unchanged when the prop is absent.

LoginPolicyState gains availableClientPortalSsoProviders (from listClientPortalAvailableSsoProviders); get/update login policy actions return it and LoginPolicyUpdate accepts clientPortalSsoProviders.

LoginPolicySettings renders a 'Client portal sign-in options' Checkbox group (one per available provider, checked = in effective list; muted note when none available); toggling saves the full resulting list and reverts with the existing alerts on failure; card description reworded to cover SSO options.

Add loginPolicy.clientPortalSso.* strings (title, body, provider labels, none-available note) and loginPolicy.guard.client_portal_sso_provider_invalid to every msp/settings locale incl. pseudo xx/yy; validate-translations passes.
CE stubs (packages/ee/src/lib/actions/auth/loginPolicy.ts) mirror the new LoginPolicyState/LoginPolicyUpdate fields and guard code.

Delete ee/server/src/components/auth/SsoProviderButtons.tsx; @alga-psa/auth/sso/entry resolves to packages/auth/src/components/SsoProviderButtons.tsx in both editions (server/next.config.mjs both alias blocks + webpack resolve-plugin rewrite, ee/server/next.config.mjs); remove the LEVERAGE sso-provider-buttons marker.

Update tests encoding the old CE/EE split: editionSwapping.test.ts expects the shared SSO entry in both editions; ssoProviderEditionGate.unit.test.tsx renders the single component under both editions; delete ssoProviderButtons.ceEeParity.test.ts.
